app.title: Sebded Sloth OS
welcome.heading: Ansuf ɣer Sloth OS!
welcome.text: Tzemreḍ ad tɛerḍeḍ anagraw mebla ma tesbeddeḍ-t, neɣ ad t-tesbeddeḍ ɣef uselkim-ik. Asebded yettawi kra n tesdatin, s kra n yesteqsiyen kan.
region.heading: Anasiw d tamnaḍt n wakud
region.try_keyboard_hint: Aru da i usenqed n tmerna
region.note: Tzemreḍ ad ten-tbeddleḍ ticki deg yiɣewwaren n unagraw.
account.heading: Snulfu-d amiḍan-ik
account.text: S yisem-a d wawal-a uffir ara tkecmeḍ ɣer uselkim. Amiḍan-ik ad yili d anedbal, ihi ad tizmireḍ daɣen ad tbeddleḍ iɣewwaren n uselkim.
account.note: Deg usekker amezwaru, deg Ansuf ɣer Sloth, ad tferneḍ ɣef wacu ara k-d-isuter uselkim awal uffir.
account.error.name: Aru isem-ik.
account.error.username: Isem n useqdac yezmer ad yesɛu kan isekkilen imeẓyanen n teglizit, uṭṭunen, ijerriden d yijerriden n wadda, u ilaq ad ibdu s usekkil (amedya: “ana”).
account.error.mismatch: Sin wawalen uffiren ur mṣadan ara.
disk.heading: Anida ara t-nesbedd?
disk.text: Fren aḍebsi anida ara yebded Sloth OS.
disk.none: Ur d-nufi ara aḍebsi i usebded.
disk.too_small: Meẓẓi aṭas: ilaq ma drus 40 GB.
disk.removable: Wa d aḍebsi azɣaray (am USB). Tebɣiḍ s tidet ad tesbeddeḍ da?
disk.small: Cwiṭ d imeẓẓi: i wuraren, ilaq ma drus 120 GB.
disk.beside.option: Ɣer yidis n Windows (Windows d ifuyla-s ad qqimen)
disk.beside.erase: Kkes aḍebsi akk (Windows d yifuyla akk ad ṛuḥen)
disk.beside.size: Tallunt i Sloth OS: {size} GB (ugar n {max} GB ala)
disk.beside.not_uefi: Aselkim yekker s uskar aqbur (BIOS), ihi ur nezmir ara ad nesbedd ɣer yidis n Windows. Ma yella aselkim-ik yessefrak-it, rmed askar UEFI deg yiɣewwaren-is, sakin ales asenker seg USB.
disk.beside.not_gpt: Aḍebsi-a yesseqdac tafelwit n yibḍan taqburt (MBR), ihi ur nezmir ara ad nesbedd ɣer yidis n Windows.
disk.beside.hibernated: Windows ur yensi ara akk (asenker arurad neɣ asgunfu), ihi tura ur nezmir ara ad nennal tabṛaṛt-is. Sekker Windows, sens asenker arurad (Agalis n usenqed → Tixtiṛiyin n tezmert → Fren ayen xeddmen tqeffalin n tezmert), sakin fren “Ales asenker” syin sekker aselkim seg USB.
disk.beside.dirty: Asenqed n uḍebsi yettṛaju deg tebṛaṛt n Windows. Sekker Windows, ṛǧu alamma yekfa, sakin sekker aselkim seg USB.
disk.beside.unknown: Ur nezmir ara ad nesenqed tabṛaṛt n Windows, ihi ur as-nbeddel ara teɣzi.
disk.beside.bitlocker: Tabṛaṛt n Windows tettwawgelhen s BitLocker ur tezmir ara ad temẓi seg da. Deg Windows, ldi Asefrek n yiḍebsiyen (asiti ayeffus ɣef C: → Ssemẓi ableɣ), serreḥ ɣef 40 GB ma drus, sakin ales asekker n umsebded: ad nesbedd deg tallunt yettwasserḥen.
disk.beside.no_space: Ulac tallunt i d-yeqqimen ɣer yidis n Windows: Sloth OS yesra 40 GB ma drus, ula d Windows yesra tallunt tilellit.
disk.encrypt.hint: Ma yettwaker neɣ iruḥ-ak uselkim, yiwen ur yezmir ad yaweḍ ɣer yifuyla-k. Ilaq ad d-tesqedceḍ awal uffir yal tikkelt ara t-tesreḥeḍ.
disk.encrypt.same: Yiwen n wawal uffir am umiḍan-iw
disk.encrypt.warning: Ma yella tettuḍ awal-a uffir, ifuyla-k ur ttuɣalen ara. Aru-t, tḥerzeḍ-t deg wadeg yettwaḍmanen.
disk.encrypt.mismatch: Sin wawalen uffiren ur mṣadan ara.
disk.encrypt.short: Awal uffir ilaq ad yesɛu 8 n yisekkilen ma drus.
disk.encrypt.short_same: Awal uffir n umiḍan-ik yedra ɣef 8 n yisekkilen: sekcem awal uffir nniḍen, ɣezzifen, i uwgelhen.
confirm.heading: Ayen akk yellan deg uḍebsi-a ad yettwakkes
confirm.text: Sloth OS ad yesseqdec aḍebsi akk: {disk}. Ayen akk yellan tura (ifuyla, ihilen, inagrawen nniḍen) ad yettwakkes i lebda.
confirm.windows: Deg uḍebsi-a yella Windows. Seld asebded, Windows d yifuyla-s akk ad ruḥen. Ma tebɣiḍ ad ten-teǧǧeḍ, eg qbel aḥraz n yifuyla-k.
confirm.checkbox: Fehmeɣ belli isefka akk n uḍebsi ad ttwakksen
confirm.beside.heading: Windows ad yeqqim
confirm.beside.text: Sloth OS ad yawi {size} GB deg uḍebsi-a: {disk}. Windows d yifuyla-s ad qqimen.
confirm.beside.shrink: I waya ad nessemẓi tabṛaṛt n Windows s {size} GB. S umata ur yesɛi ara ugur, maca ma yeḍra kra deg tallit-a (amedya ad yexsi ttrisiti), isefka zemren ad ṛuḥen, ihi qbel kullec eg anɣel i yifuyla-k yesɛan azal.
confirm.beside.free: Ad yettwasbedd deg tallunt tilellit n uḍebsi; ur nennal ara Windows.
confirm.beside.bitlocker: Windows yettwawgelhen s BitLocker: tikkelt i d-iteddun ara yekker yezmer ad d-yessuter tasarut n tririt. Ǧǧ-itt ɣer yidis-ik (aka.ms/myrecoverykey).
confirm.beside.menu: Mi ara tesreḥeḍ aselkim, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ gar Sloth OS d Windows kra n tsinin.
confirm.beside.checkbox: Fehmeɣ, ɣaseɣ anɣel n yifuyla-inu yesɛan azal
confirm.encrypt: Aḍebsi ad yettwawgelhen: ad yeldi s wawal-ik uffir mi ara yekker uselkim.
stage.shrink: Abeddel n teɣzi n tebṛaṛt n Windows…
stage.copy: Anɣal n Sloth OS ɣer uḍebsi…
install.note: Ɣef leḥsab n uselkim-ik, aya yettawi 5–20 n tesdatin. Ur t-sexsay ara.
done.heading: Asebded ifuk!
done.text: Ales asekker n uselkim. Mi yeɣli ugdil, kkes tasarut USB. Syin kcem s umiḍan i d-tesnulfaḍ akka tura; Ansuf ɣer Sloth ad ak-d-yefk afus i wayen d-yeqqimen.
done.beside: Mi ara tesreḥeḍ aselkim, tzemreḍ ad tferneḍ gar Sloth OS d Windows.
error.heading: Asebded ur yeddi ara
error.log_hint_save: Ma tsutreḍ tallalt, sekles aɣmis (amedya ɣef tsarut USB) sakin azen-it.
error.log_save_failed: Ur yezmir ara ad yettwasekles uɣmis. Ɛreḍ adeg-nniḍen, amedya tasarut USB.
error.not_authorized: Ur d-nwi ara tasiregt n usebded.
error.image_broken: Ifuyla n usebded ɣef USB ṭṭerḍen neɣ ur ummden ara. Ulac ayen yettwabeddlen ɣef uḍebsi-ik. Ales asader n umsebded, aru-t ɣef USB (neɣ seqdec USB nniḍen). Ma yella yettales-d, sekles aɣmis, tazneḍ-aɣ-t-id.
error.bad_disk: Ur yezmir ara ad yebded deg uḍebsi-a. Fren wayeḍ.
error.bad_input: Yiwen seg yiɣewwaren ur yeɣbel ara. Uɣal ɣer deffir, senqed-iten.
error.install_failed: Yella wugur deg unɣal n unagraw ɣer uḍebsi. Isefka yellan deg uḍebsi zemren ad ttwakksen yakan.
error.configure_failed: Anagraw yebded, maca tutlayt d unasiw ur ttwasbedden ara. Ɛreḍ tikkelt nniḍen; ma ur yeddi ara, tzemreḍ ad ten-tesbeddeḍ deg yiɣewwaren n unagraw seld asekker amenzu.
error.beside_shrink_failed: Ur tezmir ara tebṛaṛt n Windows ad temẓi. Sekker Windows, senqed aḍebsi (PC-a → C: → Timeẓliwin → Ifecka → Senqed), sakin ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen.
error.encrypt_failed: Asbadu n uwgelhen ur yeddi ara. Ɛreḍ tikkelt-nniḍen; ma yella mazal, sebded war awgelhen.
confirm.summary.formatted: Sbedd EFI d tnezduɣt tamaynut am FAT32 d Btrfs.
confirm.summary.encrypted: Sbeddet amyag EFI am FAT32 u sserseḍ aselkim n Sloth OS s LUKS2 d Btrfs; snulfu-d amyag n usebded yeffɣen.
confirm.summary.erase: Ssusem asmel-a, gar-as tiɣbula d ifayluyen-is i yellan tura.
confirm.beside.first_boot: Mi ara tbeddeḍ Windows tikkelt tamezwarut deffir usekles, yezmer ad d-iban Askan d useggem n usrid . Ḥader aselkim yettwaqqen deg usrid u ǧǧ-it ad ifakk.
confirm.summary.heading: Imgaraden n usegmu yettwaheggi
confirm.summary.create_all: Snulfu tasemɣart n GPT tamaynut s tferka n uselkem n BIOS, tferqa n EFI, tfarka n usenfar n Sloth OS, akked umkan n usekles amseddas.
confirm.summary.shrink: Sserseḍ amḍiq n Windows s {size} GiB, syin ssexdem amkan-nni yettwaferken i SlothOS.
confirm.summary.temporary: Amkan n usekles amseddas yettwafrim am ext4, yettwafermed deg tallit n useggem, yerna yettwakkes mi ara ifakk usegdem.
confirm.summary.free: Seqdec amkan i d-yeffɣen deg usrid-a; tiferniwin illan ur d-ttwaqqalen ara.
confirm.summary.keep_windows: Ḥerrez Windows d ifayluyen-is. Snulfu-d Sloth OS EFI d tifernin n usenfar deg umkan i yellan.
